data: In fiscal 2024 (the year ended June 30, 2024), Microsoft reported revenue of $245.1 billion, up 16% from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023. Gross profit was $171.0 billion, which works out to a gross margin of about 69.8%. Operating income was $109.4 billion, an operating margin of about 44.6%, up from $88.5 billion (41.8%) the prior year. These figures come from my recollection of Microsoft's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K rather than a live lookup, so check them against the filing if you need exact numbers.
